scope: C-shim modular partial correctness under the explicit public memory contract; ISA/ABI refinement and termination are separate obligations

sources.label: Official Arm A64 instruction PDF, aarchmrs/pseudocode v2025-03_rel
sources.review: SRSHL reads signed low8 count, clamps through ShiftSat, shifts mathematically with rounding on right shifts, then retains low32. Signed32 right rounding counts >=32 yield zero; left counts >=32 retain zero low32.

sources.label: RISC-V Vector1.0
sources.review: VSSRA uses low log2(SEW) count bits and vxrm rounding; RNU increments by discarded bit d-1. VSLL masks count to5 at SEW32. Vmul/vmacc retain low32. Narrowing clips and saturating adds round/saturate in the stated order.

configuration.inactive: Unobserved inactive C-shim fields concretized zero; no ISA-policy refinement claim
configuration.observed: Output signed-byte equality, both input arrays and parameters preserved, spatial frame; QC/vxsat excluded
configuration.size_t_model: Explicit unsigned long long64 in formal/self-contained C-shim TU, checked QCP UINT64 sizeof8 and native width8; full0..2^64-1 value domain
configuration.native_type_bridge: Raw original-source TU uses system LP64 size_t; formal-field native TU uses matching explicit ULL prototypes and private byte utilities. Width/value projection only; ABI/type-identity refinement remains open.
configuration.known_backend_long_gap: QCP --arch64 parses bare unsigned long as UINT32. Formal consumed size_t no longer uses it; old C results withdrawn and archived.
configuration.known_backend_cast_gap: Actual false QCP targets for some same-width/expression unsigned-to-signed casts are retained. The repaired control avoids these casts with independently proved bounded arithmetic; primitives remain distinct.

integer_rules.widen_subtract: signed8 minus signed8, exact signed16 result
integer_rules.multiply_accumulate: first multiply wraps32, then add the second wrapped product modulo32; RVV macc has the same low32 result
integer_rules.raw_shift: Every int32 raw shift is admitted. Actual repaired C computes t=-(raw%256), subtracts256 ift>127 and adds256 ift<-128. This equals signedlow8(-raw) for allZ; raw256 and INT32_MIN give count0. Only the NEON SRSHL observed count and RVV selection control are replaced.
integer_rules.neon_shift: Signed low8 control >=0 means wrapping left; negative means rounded arithmetic right with ties toward positive infinity
integer_rules.rvv_original: VSSRA masks low5 count and always shifts right; it is not NEON SRSHL
integer_rules.rvv_repaired_control: zero when decoded control lies outside (-32,32); RNU right for negative control, wrapping left otherwise
integer_rules.narrowing: signed32->sat16, signed saturating output-zero-point add16, sat8, then max(low) followed by min(high)
integer_rules.bias: Original sources do not read scalar.bias; it is preserved and is not silently added to the arithmetic
